{{Quote|You want a bowl of dreezel? How about a basket of pallie?|Anabar greets Qui-Gon Jinn|audio=Anabar.flac|<ref name="Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' video game]]</ref>}}
'''Anabar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] who lived in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|blockade]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. He sold bowls of [[Dweezel/Legends|dweezel]] and baskets of [[Pallie/Legends|pallie]] just outside of the [[Mos Espa Grand Arena/Legends|Mos Espa Grand Arena]] and was an acquaintance of fellow merchant, [[Grendle]].

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)}}
Grendle recommended Anabar to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] when the Jedi sought something "a little more dangerous" than [[chokie]]. Anabar refused to give the Jedi Master a [[plasma fusion trigger]] or a [[proton missile launcher]], but did not mind giving Jinn a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]] instead. Despite rejecting Jinn's [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] at first, he soon changed his mind thanks to his customer's [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]].
{{Endgame}}

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Anabar appears in [[1999]]'s [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' video game]]. The player, in the guise of Jinn, may choose to talk to Anabar and acquire a detonator. This article assumes 100% game completion, and the game's strategy guide recommends the course of action for acquiring a thermal detonator.
